query:
-- IA Senate: Turek/Wahls (D primary), Carlin/Hinson (R primary)
UPDATE senate_races 
SET candidate1_name = 'TBD — D Primary: Josh Turek vs Zach Wahls (June 2)',
    candidate2_name = 'TBD — R Primary: Jim Carlin vs Ashley Hinson (June 2)'
WHERE state_code = 'IA';

-- MT Senate: Steve Daines NOT running (withdrew); R primary: Alme/Calhoun/Walking Child; D primary TBD
UPDATE senate_races 
SET candidate1_name = 'TBD — D Primary: June 2, 2026',
    candidate2_name = 'TBD — R Primary: Kurt Alme vs Lee Calhoun vs Charles Walking Child (June 2)',
    notes = 'Open seat — Steve Daines withdrew. Seth Bodnar running as Independent in general.'
WHERE state_code = 'MT';

-- NJ Senate: Cory Booker (D, unopposed); R primary: Murphy/Tabor/Lebovics/Zdan
UPDATE senate_races 
SET candidate1_name = 'Cory Booker (incumbent)',
    candidate2_name = 'TBD — R Primary: Murphy/Tabor/Lebovics/Zdan (June 2)'
WHERE state_code = 'NJ';

-- NM Senate: Ben Ray Luján (D, incumbent); R primary: Larry Marker (write-in only)
UPDATE senate_races 
SET candidate1_name = 'Ben Ray Luján (incumbent)',
    candidate2_name = 'TBD — R Primary: Larry Marker (write-in, June 2)',
    notes = 'R candidate Christopher Heuvel was disqualified. Larry Marker qualified as write-in only — must get 2,351 write-in votes to advance.'
WHERE state_code = 'NM';

-- SD Senate: Mike Rounds (R, incumbent); D: Julian Beaudion (D primary canceled — sole candidate)
UPDATE senate_races 
SET candidate1_name = 'Julian Beaudion',
    candidate2_name = 'Mike Rounds (incumbent)'
WHERE state_code = 'SD';

-- Verify all 5 updates
SELECT state_code, candidate1_name, candidate2_name, status FROM senate_races 
WHERE state_code IN ('IA','MT','NJ','NM','SD') ORDER BY state_code;
